summary: No-ship: the quota bump fixes today's payload, but the claimed regression guard stays green when the same unbounded-download failure recurs; mandatory trap registration is also missing.
triage: review-gate SKILL.md rules govern: render EVERY finding as a full table row, the human decides each row (accept/reject/defer/question — free text), echo back before applying, max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: The regression guard cannot detect recurrence of the diagnosed root cause
findings.body: MEASURED_PAYLOAD_KIB is a fixed 2026-07-25 observation, so this test always approves 512Mi regardless of what Grafana currently downloads. The production path remains unbounded and unversioned at grafana.yaml:25, while these comments acknowledge automatic upstream growth. Once the runtime payload exceeds 512Mi, the same eviction loop and downstream VictoriaLogs OOM cascade can recur while the required gate remains green. This is a capacity mitigation, not a regression lock on the diagnosed cause.
findings.recommendation: Either make the complete plugin payload immutable—such as a pinned custom image with runtime preinstall disabled—and derive the budget from that artifact, or add an automated current-payload bootstrap probe plus runtime overflow detection before treating this test as a recurrence guard.

findings.title: The new live-verified trap is omitted from the mandatory SSOT and enforcement ledger
findings.body: The diagnosis explicitly defers registering this live-verified trap, despite docs/traps.md:11 requiring every new guard test to be added to the ledger and docs/traps-detail.md being the trap SSOT. Without registration, deletion or renaming of this guard will not be caught by verify-traps, defeating the repository's guard-lifecycle protection.
findings.recommendation: Before merge, add the trap to docs/traps-detail.md, add the corresponding guard row to docs/traps.md, add the matching AGENTS.md index entry, and run test_traps-sync.bats.

next_steps: Replace or supplement the historical-size assertion with evidence tied to the current or immutable plugin payload.
Register the new trap and guard in all required SSOT/index files, then rerun the required gate.
